mapper.select: /* 검진기록 단건 조회(연결 일정이 삭제됐어도 포함) */ SELECT C.CKUP_RCD_SN , S.PET_SN , C.SCHDL_SN , DATE(S.SCHDL_DT) AS CKUP_YMD , C.HSPTL_NM , C.CKUP_TYPE_CD , T.COM_CD_NM AS CKUP_TYPE_CD_NM , C.CKUP_CN , C.CKUP_MEMO_CN , C.RECPT_SN FROM CKUP_RCD C JOIN SCHDL S ON S.SCHDL_SN = C.SCHDL_SN LEFT JOIN COM_CD T ON T.COM_CD = C.CKUP_TYPE_CD AND T.COM_CD_PRNT_SN IS NOT NULL WHERE C.CKUP_RCD_SN = #{ckupRcdSn} AND C.CKUP_RCD_STTS_CD = #{completedCd} AND C.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* 검진기록의 처방·반복 예방 케어 항목 삭제 처리 */ UPDATE CARE_ARTCL SET DEL_YN = 'Y' , MDFR_ID = #{actorId} , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND ( PRSC_SN IN ( SELECT P.PRSC_SN FROM PRSC P WHERE P.CKUP_RCD_SN = #{ckupRcdSn} ) OR REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN IN ( SELECT R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN FROM REPT_PRVNT_MNG R WHERE R.CKUP_RCD_SN = #{ckupRcdSn} ) )

/* 검진기록의 케어 항목 반려동물 변경 */ UPDATE CARE_ARTCL SET PET_SN = #{petSn} , MAIN_EXPSR_YN = 'N' , MAIN_SORT_SEQ = 0 , MDFR_ID = #{actorId} , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE PRSC_SN IN ( SELECT P.PRSC_SN FROM PRSC P WHERE P.CKUP_RCD_SN = #{ckupRcdSn} ) OR REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN IN ( SELECT R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN FROM REPT_PRVNT_MNG R WHERE R.CKUP_RCD_SN = #{ckupRcdSn} )
